The agent authenticates Tessa Coleman, swaps both items on retail order #W3916708 (issuing an $8.90 refund), recovers from two 600s timeouts to process a $38 refund and issue a $100 travel certificate for Maya Chen, then books a flight and three hotels and runs product searches. Throughout, the agent leans on working-memory recall for prior values while re-retrieving from the database where needed.
